thread:
Alex (PM): ok team — quick sync: we need a compact launch criteria + rollback plan for the upcoming 8-partner pilot. aiming to finalize by EOD Fri. suggestions? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Nia (ProdOps): can we scope it to 4 primary success signals? reduces negotiation back-and-forth. my proposal: 1) onboarding completion rate >= 75% within 7 days, 2) 95th-pct API latency < 250ms, 3) no P0 bugs for 72h after each rollout, 4) qualitative NPS >= 6/10 from partner feedback surveys.
Ben (Res): those are reasonable. add: sample size threshold for quality checks — at least 50 generated sessions per partner before we count the NPS.
Priya (AE): on incentives — partners asked for waived support fees + 2 months of free usage credits. that buys us better engagement. also recommend a short weekly office hour to keep momentum. :calendar:
Elliot (Eng): technical rollback criteria: if model error-rate (runtime exceptions / requests) > 0.5% for 1 hour OR token-usage cost deviation > 2x expected baseline for 30m, we auto-fallback to stable 1.0 model and open incident. how does that align?
Alex (PM): good. I also want a prompt-regression guardrail: if automated evals on our golden prompt set show a BLEU/score drop > 5% vs baseline for two consecutive runs, pause rollout. might be noisy but useful.
Nia (ProdOps): agree on evals, but let's make the threshold configurable per partner. some partners run longer contexts.
Ben (Res): for qualitative data capture — proposed survey template in thread: 
```
Q1: Did the system help you complete your task? (Y/N)
Q2: Ease of integrating SDK (1-5)
Q3: Any correctness failures? Short description
Q4: Would you recommend this pilot to other teams? (1-10)
```
Alex (PM): nice. we should tag responses with partner id and feature flags active.
Priya (AE): logistics: I'll draft partner email with incentive terms + weekly OH invite. do we want a short SLA that explains rollback behavior so partners aren't surprised?
Elliot (Eng): yes — include a section: "automated fallback and expected service interruption window (typically <5m)". also list contact for emergency bypass.
Alex (PM): tasking: Priya — draft messaging and incentive offer by Wed. Nia — implement dashboard widgets for the 4 signals + per-partner eval toggle by Thu. Elliot — add the two rollback monitors and a scripted toggle to fallback model by Thu EOD. Ben — finalize survey + 3 quick interview scripts by Thu. I'll collate and publish final criteria on Friday.
LaunchBot: Reminder: this thread will be archived in 30 days unless pinned.
Nia (ProdOps): quick Q — onboarding completion metric: what counts as completion? initial API key use + first successful inference?
Alex (PM): yes: partner has successfully called /generate and has at least one response saved to their workspace. we'll document exact event IDs in the runbook.
Priya (AE): one more: can we include a small $500 stipend per partner for time spent on feedback sessions? gets buy-in.
Ben (Res): yes, and compensate for engineering time where necessary.
Elliot (Eng): ack on engineering resource — may need pull from next sprint. I'll flag scope in my tracker.
Alex (PM): ok great. if no objections I'll lock this plan and send to partners Fri AM. :white_check_mark:
Priya (AE): no objections from me.
Ben (Res): good to go.
Nia (ProdOps): good.
Elliot (Eng): thumbs up.
Alex (PM): thanks all — I'll post the runbook link once it's live.
